'''Govin Thane''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], stationed in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Lacking compassion, morals, or mercy, Thane was assigned to track down a group of Rebel refugees within Cloud City and hoped for a slaughter as he and his team of Imperial operatives and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] went about it. He hired [[Jodo Kast]] and [[Zardra]] to seize a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] with the location of the refugees.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
